built_from: 50 Robin X/Twitter posts (casual voice baseline for TikTok and Instagram content)

fingerprint.sentence_length: extremely short — 51.5% of lines are 5 words or fewer. Lines are punchy standalone statements, not full sentences. Each line can stand alone. Medium lines (6-12 words) fill the gaps at 43%. Long sentences almost never appear
fingerprint.paragraph_length: 1-3 words to 1 short sentence per line. Lots of line breaks. Single-word lines are acceptable. Reads like a conversation, not a paragraph
fingerprint.opener_style: lowercase or ALL CAPS — 32% of posts start lowercase (casual vibe), 6% use ALL CAPS for excitement/celebration. pov: format used for story setups. Contrarian openers common ('Don't use Cursor', '$5/month is too expensive'). Self-deprecating openers work well ('I'm stupid', 'I love working 9-5'). Celebration openers for milestones ('WE CROSSED $1000 MRR')
fingerprint.word_choice: conversational and unfiltered — 'gonna', 'gotta', 'af', 'wtf', 'lol'. Actual Robin signature phrases: 'this changed my life', 'I'm living the dream', 'no one's coming to save us', 'becoming successful is the only option'. Short simple words preferred over sophisticated vocabulary. Numbers and money amounts create engagement ($1M ARR, $700 in sales)
fingerprint.punctuation: minimal punctuation overall. lowercase default. Emojis in 26% of posts — used for celebration (🎉), reactions (😭), or emphasis (👎). Multiple exclamation marks for milestone posts. No comma-heavy complex sentences. Ellipsis sometimes for cliffhangers
fingerprint.first_person: very high — raw personal experience is the content. 'I made', 'we crossed', 'I'm done', 'I quit'. Shares wins unabashedly. Shares failures and stupid mistakes too. Authentic vulnerability is a feature, not a bug
fingerprint.cta_style: question or challenge — 'what's your move?', 'be honest', 'keep going guys', 'reply below'. Inclusive language: 'grinding until we're all millionaires', 'keep going friends'. Sometimes no CTA at all — drops the mic and leaves

examples: $5/month for a VPS is too expensive.
Don't use Cursor for new Projects.
I love working 9-5 on a monday

hook_patterns.pattern: [Milestone or achievement] — ALL CAPS or emoji explosion

examples: pov: you're getting rich with your friends
pov: building a startup in a barber shop in africa
I'm stupid — accidentally purchased my own product today while testing
I'm turning 24 tomorrow — still haven't made it…
this changed my life! [then lists contrast of last year vs this year]
imagine this: you get a macbook, no job, you're broke — you have 30 days to make $1,000 online — what's your move?

localization_de.note: German TikTok uses this same casual profile with DE localization applied on top. Apply casual fingerprint first, then adapt to German idioms.
principles: Preserve the raw energy — 'brooo' energy in German (Alter, Bruder, krass)
Keep it lowercase where German grammar allows it
Adapt money/milestone posts to German entrepreneur culture — same raw excitement
Do NOT literal-translate — find German phrases that carry the same casual punch
Avoid formal German grammar constructions that sound stiff — use spoken German

banned_patterns: Follow me for more content like this
Don't forget to like and subscribe
